Range Intelligent Computing.why: Invests in, builds, owns and operates campus-scale AI data centers (AIDC) in China and overseas, leasing wholesale IDC cabinets to internet and cloud majors and running its own AI compute clusters for AI-model customers, so AI compute build-out drives its capacity, revenue and capex.
Range Intelligent Computing.evidence: Range Intelligent Computing half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026): AIDC compute business revenue RMB 19.95 hundred million in H1 2026, up 126.24%, 53.26% of revenue; IDC business provides high-end cabinet hosting to internet and cloud head customers on a wholesale model.

players.product: AIDC (AI data-center) campuses and AI compute services: nine AI infrastructure clusters (Langfang in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Pinghu, Foshan, Huizhou, Chongqing, Lanzhou, Danzhou; Sha Ling, Hong Kong; Batam, Indonesia), wholesale IDC cabinets for internet and cloud majors

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Segments (half-year report, H1 2026): AIDC compute business revenue RMB 1,994,987,414.82, up 126.24%, gross margin 47.33% (down 6.59 points), now 53.26% of revenue and ahead of the IDC cabinet business, which the company calls its core growth engine; IDC business revenue RMB 1,750,706,632.23, up 8.44%, gross margin 45.73% (down 1.19 points). quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Deliveries and overseas build-out (half-year report): within 2026 the company will newly deliver part of the computing centers at its Langfang, Pinghu, Chongqing, Foshan, Huizhou and Batam parks. Overseas it set up two core nodes in 2026, Sha Ling (Hong Kong) and Batam (Indonesia), through self-build and acquisition, with about 600MW of medium/short-term planned scale; the Batam park is expected to deliver part of its computing centers within 2026 and can later expand to a GW-class intelligent computing park, while the Hong Kong park is expected to deliver within 2028. It is sending an overseas O&M team of more than 300 engineers and exporting cooling and power-distribution equipment as integrated high-density modules. Acquired in the period (non-common-control business combinations): PT Equator Gate System Batam, Equatorial Holding and Equator Gate System Pte. Ltd.
quarterly_data.figure: Batam partial delivery within 2026; Hong Kong park delivery within 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Liquid cooling (half-year report): the company delivered what it calls the industry's first all-liquid-cooled intelligent computing building in 2023; since 2025 its self-developed cold-plate liquid cooling has been applied across several parks at more than 45kW per cabinet. It calls itself one of the earliest third-party providers to deploy high-performance domestic liquid-cooled compute at scale. In H1 2026 it completed green-power trading of more than 11 hundred million kWh, and 8 of its computing-center buildings are on the national green data center lists.
quarterly_data.figure: Cold-plate liquid cooling at more than 45kW per cabinet
